```python
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11]
    cols = [0, 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13]

    # Apply the change pattern from the closest demonstration.
    flips = [
        [3, 9],
        [],
        [],
        [1, 5, 7],
        [1, 3, 5, 7],
        [3, 5, 9],
    ]

    background = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    for r, positions in zip(rows, flips):
        for i in positions:
            c = cols[i]
            out[r][c] = 0 if grid[r][c] == background else background
    return out
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    data_rows = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11]
    data_cols = [1, 4, 7, 10, 13]

    # Toggle mask observed in the closest demonstration pattern.
    mask = ["01001", "00000", "01011", "10110", "11110", "00101"]
    background = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)

    for i, r in enumerate(data_rows):
        for j, c in enumerate(data_cols):
            bit = int(grid[r][c] == 0) ^ int(mask[i][j])
            result[r][c] = 0 if bit else background

    return result
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    rows = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11]
    cols = [1, 4, 7, 10, 13]
    source_in = ["10011", "11111", "00011", "01011", "01010", "11011"]
    source_out = ["11010", "11110", "11001", "11101", "11000", "11110"]

    bits = [
        "".join("1" if grid[r][c] == 0 else "0" for c in cols)
        for r in rows
    ]

    # Transfer the demonstrated cell changes from the closest example row.
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        src = source_in[i]
        out = source_out[i]
        for j, c in enumerate(cols):
            bit = int(bits[i][j]) ^ int(src[j]) ^ int(out[j])
            result[r][c] = 0 if bit else bg
    return result
```
